title: Aircraft Design
description: Flight vehicle conceptual and preliminary design. Market analysis. Mission requirements, sizing, trade-offs. Aircraft general arrangement, fuselage, wing, empennage, landing gear design. Weight and balance. Stability and control. Drag polar. Aircraft structural arrangement, maneuvering envelope. Project.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of MECH 475, MECH 538, MECH 580 (if taken in the same topic) ASE 504.
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
